subject: Request: MAP, private-offer billing flow, and acceptance milestones — Arcturus Health
messages:
From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@arcturushealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, procurement@arcturushealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP and private-offer questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team is excited. Procurement asked me to put together a short list of items we need to close this out on our side. Can you share Redwood's mutual action plan (MAP) specifically for marketplace private-offers (AWS/GCP/Azure), plus a clear billing path (invoicing vs. marketplace charge), and the typical procurement steps?

Two constraints on our side: we need the private-offer to be visible in our AWS Marketplace console and the legal team needs SOC 2 evidence before signature. Also, we're looking to compress the timeline to ~4 weeks if possible.

Could you:
- Share a one-page MAP with owners and milestones
- Confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO (net 45) while also using a private-offer through AWS
- Provide the contact for Redwood billing/AP

Thanks — Elena

Elena Rios
Vendor Relations — Arcturus Health
elena.rios@arcturushealth.com
procurement@arcturushealth.com

Attachment: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@arcturushealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and private-offer questions

Elena — great to hear, and totally doable. TL;DR: we can run an accelerated MAP targeting a 3–5 week close, use an AWS private offer that appears in your Marketplace console, and accept a Redwood PO (net 45) paired with the private-offer acceptance. Below is a concise MAP and the immediate next steps. I've attached the MAP workbook and a draft private-offer template for your legal/procurement.

Attachments:
- redwood_marketplace_map_v1.xlsx (XLSX) — MAP with owners, milestones, acceptance criteria
- redwood_private_offer_template.pdf (PDF) — draft private offer + commercial terms

High-level MAP (owners & milestones)
1) Week 0 (Discovery & sign-off):
   - Owner: Elena / Arcturus procurement
   - Redwood owner: Vivek (sales)
   - Deliverables: confirm SKU list, target start date, sign NDA (if needed)
2) Week 1 (Technical eval):
   - Owner: Soojin Lee (Solutions Eng)
   - Deliverables: perf/latency test run, test prompts, acceptance criteria doc
3) Week 2 (Security & legal):
   - Owner: Arcturus security + Redwood legal (cc: SOC link below)
   - Deliverables: SOC 2 evidence, IP/data handling notes, redlines to private-offer
4) Week 3 (Commercial & procurement):
   - Owner: Jonas Weber (Finance/Billing) + Arcturus procurement
   - Deliverables: private-offer issued in AWS, PO signed (net 45), confirmation of billing path
5) Week 4 (Production enablement):
   - Owner: Soojin + Vivek
   - Deliverables: model pinning, routing config, runbook handoff, invoice/first charge verification

Billing & private-offer specifics
- We will issue an AWS private offer tied to the agreed SKUs. Once you accept the offer in the AWS console it becomes billable through AWS (AWS bill) and Redwood will also accept a Redwood-side PO for our records/payables.
- If you want invoicing (Redwood invoice to Arcturus), Jonas can set up a Net-45 invoice cadence and coordinate with your AP team — both flows are supported.

Immediate asks from Redwood to help accelerate:
- Confirm SKUs + expected monthly usage (so we can size the private-offer)
- Point person for legal redlines
- AP contact to receive PO/invoice (we can also send a consolidated billing workflow)

Links & assets
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890
- SOC 2: https://s3.redwood.com/security/soc2_report_2026.pdf
- DocuSign (sample PO): https://docusign.com/link/abc123

Next step: I propose a short 30-min alignment call this afternoon to lock week-0 deliverables. Soojin, would you be available to run the tech acceptance checklist?

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@arcturushealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@arcturushealth.com, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and private-offer questions

Thanks Vivek — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications:
- Can the private-offer be configured to appear in our AWS console within 48 hours of receiving the final SKU list?
- Our legal wants to review the private-offer redlines and the SOC 2 report — will the PDF link above suffice or do we need to send anything else?
- AP: please send invoices to ap@arcturushealth.com (POs come from procurement@arcturushealth.com). We are aiming to close in 4 weeks; if Redwood can commit to the timeline we'll prioritize internal reviews.

On the timeline: we may need a slightly compressed security review (Week 2) — can Soojin coordinate with our security engineer Daniel Park to run through the acceptance checklist? I'll schedule a parallel meeting for legal & procurement tomorrow.

Elena

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and private-offer questions — next steps and PO flow

Elena — thanks. Quick confirmations and owners so we can lock the 4-week plan: 

Immediate checklist (what Redwood will do this week)
- Today: Redwood to prepare and send final MAP workbook + draft private-offer (attached). Owner: Vivek
- 48 hrs: Private-offer published to AWS (so it appears in your console once accepted). Owner: Jonas
- 72 hrs: Send DocuSign PO (sample link above) and Redwood invoice template if you prefer invoice flow. Owner: Jonas
- Week 1: Soojin to run technical acceptance tests with Arcturus (Daniel). Owner: Soojin

AP / invoicing details
- AP contact at Arcturus: ap@arcturushealth.com
- Redwood billing contact: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
- Payment terms: Redwood can accept PO (Net 45) and also support AWS-managed billing through the private-offer. If you accept via AWS, charges will appear on the AWS invoice; Redwood will also issue an internal invoice/receipt for your records if needed.

Attachments included:
- purchase_order_template.docx (DOCX) — editable PO template
- redwood_marketplace_map_v1.xlsx (XLSX) — MAP workbook
- redwood_private_offer_template.pdf (PDF) — draft private-offer

Meeting: I've created a 30-min alignment slot tomorrow 10:00am PT to lock SKUs and owners. If that works I'll send the invite.

If you want to accelerate to 3 weeks we can compress the security window by running the SOC review in parallel with legal redlines — happy to coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

— Vivek
